svg.title: FM-1 tracker control map
svg.desc: FM-1 top panel, based on the device reference photograph. MASTER and SELECT are at the upper left; PRESETS and ALGORITHM below them; OCT minus and OCT plus beneath. The square tracker display is in the center. KNOB1 through KNOB4 are at the upper right. Two rows of function buttons beneath them read FX, SEL, ENV, LFO, EDIT, GLO, then HOME, SAVE, ARP, SEQ, PLAY STOP, REC. Sixteen lower piano pads and eleven upper chromatic pads span the bottom. Added note labels show pitches at keyboard octave OC minus one.
svg.text: Piano labels show the default OC −1 octave. SEL is the physical label for the firmware's SCL action.
